claims: Ed Harris is an American actor.
Ed Harris has earned four Academy Award nominations.
Ed Harris has not won an Oscar.
Ed Harris received a Best Supporting Actor Oscar nomination for Apollo 13 (1995).
Ed Harris received a Best Supporting Actor Oscar nomination for The Truman Show (1998).
Ed Harris received a Best Supporting Actor Oscar nomination for The Hours (2002).
Ed Harris received a Best Actor Oscar nomination for Pollock (2000).
Ed Harris received a Best Supporting Actor Oscar nomination for Apollo 13 at the 1996 ceremony.
Ed Harris received a Best Supporting Actor Oscar nomination for The Truman Show at the 1999 ceremony.
Ed Harris received a Best Actor Oscar nomination for Pollock at the 2001 ceremony.
Ed Harris received a Best Supporting Actor Oscar nomination for The Hours at the 2003 ceremony.
Ed Harris received Emmy nominations for his television roles.
Ed Harris received an Emmy nomination for his work on HBO's Westworld.
